name: Dagger Axe Lancers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Cavalry · charge cav · 245 leadership · T4M
pitch: A charge cavalry unit built around Lancer's Last Stand — big flank damage once spaced correctly, but weak in a straight duel. Not an every-map pick: open maps favor heavier chargers, while curved terrain like Western City lets it flank-path into the fight for real value.

doctrines.name: Lancer-Last Stand
doctrines.effect: +40% DMG when unit headcount is below 60%.

doctrines.name: Epic Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.effect: -50% DMG taken while charging, -6s charge CD.
doctrines.note: −50% DMG taken while charging, −6s charge CD

doctrines.name: Sprint Doctrine
doctrines.effect: +7% movement speed, unlocks Sprint: +15% movement speed for 12s.

battleRole.positioning: Go in / try to go behind the push with your hero, while the lancers stand on the opposite side of the push — they follow your hero, so send them "away" into the fight. {1} On curved-path maps like Western City, take a flanking route rather than a direct charge; on more open maps, heavier charger cavalry is more effective and Dagger Axes see less play. {2}
battleRole.tips: Charge takes 1.5s to reach final stance for full damage — you have about 10s to push through a blob before skill 2 ends. {1} X-move and/or press 2 when the lancers are 2–3s from impact so they carry through the blob. {1} Dodge pikes and enter from a better angle when you can charge in and follow up with 2. {1} Lancer's Last Stand trick: if you spawn with it, swap away and swap back; if you just lost the unit, pull it from supply (best to have it out, swap to another unit, then swap back) so the 40%-at-<60%-headcount bonus applies to the full unit instead of a partial one. {1}

controls.notes: Old "short charge" trait (max damage at zero momentum) was removed — new play is to press 2 early and maintain the charge if you can wipe in one go. {1} Prioritize the follow-charge (charge then skill 2) over charging in first and pressing 2 after; if you can't make good use of the follow-charge, fall back to a normal 1-charge and recall with skill 2 — prio should always be to use 2. {1}
